evidence.finding: Group view formed with only 2 members (node1, node2) — node3 absent from this Primary Component.

Multiple distinct new group UUIDs appear across successive restarts (01099079-..., fb1ed012-..., 50a0aaa7-...), each reporting members(2) only — indicates repeated re-formation of a 2-node primary component rather than one stable 3-node cluster.

Both node2 and node3 independently entered joiner state requiring full rsync SST ('state transfer needed: yes', Local state 00000000-...:-1), i.e. neither could do incremental state transfer (IST) — they were being treated as if they had no valid prior state.
Executor issued pkill -f mysqld_safe / pkill -f mariadbd and later kill -9 on maria/rsync processes — abrupt process kills rather than clean shutdown (e.g. systemctl stop / mysqladmin shutdown).

evidence.source: node2 filesystem check, 13:56:10 (last record before lease expiry)
evidence.finding: /var/lib/mysql still contains rsync_sst.conf, rsync_sst.pid, and sst_in_progress, but `ss -tn` shows no established connection on port 4444 — an SST session appears stale/orphaned at the moment the lease expired, with no confirmation it ever completed.

160 commands completed with no executor structured report returned, and the run was terminated by cluster_expired at 13:56:17 — the executor never reached a captured state showing wsrep_cluster_size=3 / Synced on all three nodes.
grep for 'IST' and 'Bypassing' in /var/log/messages returned no output (return_code 1 / not found), consistent with the cluster never achieving a clean incremental-state-transfer rejoin path.

likely_causes.cause: Nodes were restarted without a controlled bootstrap sequence (one designated node first with --wsrep-new-cluster, others joining sequentially afterward and confirmed Synced before the next). Instead multiple nodes appear to have raced into forming independent Primary Components, causing repeated re-election and merge cycles (evidence: 3+ distinct group UUIDs, each with only 2 members).

Abrupt process kills (pkill -9 on mariadbd/rsync) during a restart/SST attempt left the datadir in an inconsistent state (grastate.dat with seqno -1, or stale rsync_sst.* artifacts), forcing subsequent joiners into full-SST-required state rather than a fast IST, and possibly causing later SST attempts to stall against leftover lock/pid files.

node3 never durably joined the primary component — all captured post-restart views show only 2 members (node1+node2); node3 may have been stuck retrying a hung rsync SST or blocked on connectivity (port 4444/4567) at the time the lease expired.

Time budget exhaustion: repeated full-SST cycles (each requiring copying the entire datadir via rsync) combined with manual kill/retry loops consumed the cluster lease before a stable 3/3 Synced state was ever reached and verified.

next_attempt_guidance: Perform a clean, sequenced shutdown: stop mariadb with systemctl stop mariadb (or mysqladmin shutdown) on all three nodes, not pkill/kill -9, so grastate.dat correctly records the last committed seqno and safe_to_bootstrap flag.

Before restarting, inspect grastate.dat on all three nodes and identify the one with the highest seqno (or explicitly set safe_to_bootstrap: 1 on that node) — bootstrap the cluster from that node only, using `galera_new_cluster` or `mariadbd --wsrep-new-cluster`.

Start the remaining two nodes one at a time, waiting for each to report wsrep_local_state_comment = Synced and wsrep_cluster_size incrementing correctly before starting the next node — do not start all three in parallel.

If a node must do SST, let it complete or fail on its own; avoid killing mariadbd/rsync mid-transfer. If a previous SST was interrupted, clean stale artifacts (sst_in_progress, rsync_sst.pid, rsync_sst.conf) from the datadir before retrying, or wipe the joiner's datadir entirely to force a guaranteed-clean full SST.

Before initiating restarts, verify network reachability between all three nodes on the Galera ports (4567 for group comm, 4568 for IST, 4444 for rsync SST) with ss/tcpdump, since SST stalls with no established :4444 connection were observed.

Only declare the maintenance complete after confirming, on all three nodes independently, `SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size'` = 3 and `wsrep_local_state_comment` = Synced, and after spot-checking that a write committed before shutdown is present on each node.
summary: The attempt never reached a verified 3-node Synced cluster before the lease expired. Log evidence shows repeated restart cycles in which the Primary Component re-formed with only 2 members (node1+node2) under several different group UUIDs, while node2/node3 repeatedly entered joiner state requiring a full rsync SST rather than a fast IST — consistent with restarts that were not sequenced (no single bootstrap node) and with abrupt kill -9 termination of mariadbd/rsync mid-SST. The final captured state on node2, seconds before lease expiry, shows SST artifacts (sst_in_progress, rsync_sst.pid/conf) present but no active rsync connection on port 4444, i.e. a stalled/orphaned state transfer with no confirmation the cluster ever reached wsrep_cluster_size=3.</summary>
